# Mosaic

> Mosaic generates native iOS (WidgetKit, Live Activities, Dynamic Island) and Android
> (AppWidget/RemoteViews) home-screen widgets from a single Flutter-style Dart DSL. You write
> declarative `MosaicDefinition` / `MosaicLiveActivity` builder functions; `mosaic_cli build`
> emits native Swift/Kotlin/XML; the app pushes live data via `MosaicBridge`. Mosaic is not in
> model training data — always use the documented API, never invent class names or imports.

## Critical rules
- Widget/Live-Activity definition files import `package:mosaic_widgets/dsl.dart` (pure Dart). App/bridge
  code imports `package:mosaic_widgets/mosaic_widgets.dart`. Using the barrel in a definition file breaks the build.
- Definitions are pure data (no Flutter widgets / no runtime logic); all dynamism is `MBind` + data
  the app pushes. A widget's `build<Name>()` function name must exactly match its `mosaic.yaml` `name`.

## Packages (monorepo under platform/)
- `mosaic` (platform/flutter): the DSL + `MosaicBridge` / `MosaicLiveActivities` runtime API.
- `mosaic_core` (platform/core): IR, config (`mosaic.yaml`), widget runner.
- `mosaic_android` (platform/android), `mosaic_ios` (platform/ios): native code generators.
- `mosaic_cli` (platform/cli): `init` / `add widget` / `build` / `doctor` / `clean`.
